en.text:
Scoring multiple Direct Weapon Hits within 3? seconds of each grants ~20% Class Ability Energy. There is no cooldown on hits or activation procs (Hint: Use DoT Weapons).

Activation progress granted by weapon type:
• Submachine Guns, Trace Rifles: 7.14%
• Auto Rifles, Machine Guns: 8.33%
• Pulse Rifles: 9.1%
• Sidearms: 12.5%
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 16.7%
• Swords, Shotguns: 20% 
• Fusion Rifles, Bows, Glaives, Grenade Launchers, Sniper Rifles: 34%

Casting Dodge reloads all equipped weapons, collects all nearby ammo bricks within 15 meters, and grants you 1 Stack of 'Tight Fit' for 15 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks. #Reload

Allies within 15 meters receive the same number of stacks as you have after the Dodge.

Stat Bonuses at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 40|40|45|50|55 Reload Speed
• 0%|7.5%|8.5%|9%|11% decreased Reload Animation Duration
• 40?|40?|45?|50?|55? Handling
